summary: The Model Context Protocol (MCP) has become the de facto standard for connecting AI coding agents like Claude Code, Cursor, and Codex to external tools, data sources, and APIs. MCP servers transform capable but isolated LLMs into agents that can browse the web, control browsers, query databases, manage repositories, and automate SaaS workflows. The ecosystem now spans thousands of individual servers, aggregator marketplaces, and enterprise-grade gateways that manage auth and routing at scale.
ecosystem_note: Individual MCP servers expose a single tool or service (e.g. GitHub, Playwright), aggregators bundle hundreds or thousands of servers behind one managed connection with unified auth, and gateways/proxies sit in front of MCP traffic to handle routing, security, observability, and access control.

tools.name: GitHub MCP Server
tools.connects_to: GitHub repositories, issues, pull requests, Actions, code search and file operations
tools.pricing_paid: Free; usage governed by your existing GitHub plan (Free/Team/Enterprise)
strengths: Official first-party server with broad coverage of the GitHub API
Deeply integrated across Copilot, Cursor, Claude Code and VS Code
Supports both remote (hosted) and local Docker deployment
tools.best_for: Agent-driven code review, repo automation, and issue/PR management

tools.name: Playwright MCP
tools.connects_to: Browser automation — navigation, clicking, form filling, scraping and accessibility-tree-based page interaction
strengths: Deterministic, accessibility-tree-based browser control (no screenshots required)
Backed by the widely adopted Playwright project
Excellent for end-to-end testing and web interaction by agents
tools.best_for: Letting agents reliably browse, test, and automate real web applications

tools.name: Context7 MCP
tools.connects_to: Up-to-date, version-specific library and framework documentation injected directly into agent context
tools.pricing_paid: Free tier; higher API limits available via Upstash paid plans
strengths: Eliminates outdated/hallucinated API usage by fetching current docs
Extremely popular in Cursor and Claude Code workflows
Trivial setup and broad language/framework coverage
tools.best_for: Keeping coding agents aligned with current library APIs and docs

tools.name: Composio
tools.connects_to: 1,500+ SaaS apps (Gmail, Slack, Notion, Linear, Jira, GitHub, etc.) through one managed server with OAuth handled
tools.pricing_paid: Free tier; usage-based and team plans scaling with active connections/actions
strengths: Managed OAuth across 1,500+ apps removes per-integration setup
Single connection unlocks huge breadth of tools
Strong fit for multi-app agent workflows in Cursor and Claude
tools.best_for: Building agents that span many SaaS tools without custom auth plumbing

tools.name: Filesystem MCP Server
tools.connects_to: Local file system — reading, writing, searching and editing files within allowed directories
strengths: Reference server maintained alongside the MCP spec
Foundational building block used in countless agent setups
Secure directory-scoped access controls
tools.best_for: Giving agents safe, scoped access to local project files

tools.name: Figma MCP (Dev Mode)
tools.connects_to: Figma design files, components, variables and Dev Mode metadata for design-to-code generation
tools.pricing_paid: Requires a paid Figma seat with Dev Mode for full features
strengths: Official Figma server for accurate design-to-code translation
Pulls real component structure, tokens and layout data
Rapidly adopted by frontend teams using Cursor/Claude
tools.best_for: Converting Figma designs into production frontend code via agents

tools.name: Firecrawl MCP
tools.connects_to: Web scraping, crawling, and structured data extraction turning websites into LLM-ready markdown
tools.pricing_paid: Free tier with credits; paid plans from ~$16/mo scaling by crawl volume
strengths: Robust JS-rendering and anti-bot handling for real-world sites
Clean, LLM-ready output ideal for research agents
Simple MCP integration across major clients
tools.best_for: Deep web research and large-scale content extraction for agents

tools.name: Docker MCP Toolkit / Catalog
tools.connects_to: Containerized, sandboxed MCP servers via Docker Desktop's MCP Catalog and gateway with secure secret management
tools.pricing_paid: Free with Docker Desktop; Docker Business/Team plans for org controls
strengths: Runs MCP servers in isolated containers for security
Curated catalog of ready-to-run servers
Centralized secret and gateway management
tools.best_for: Securely running and managing multiple MCP servers in sandboxed containers

tools.name: Smithery
tools.connects_to: Thousands of community and official MCP servers via a searchable registry and one-click/hosted deployment
tools.pricing_paid: Free registry; paid hosting/usage tiers for managed server deployments
strengths: Largest discovery registry for MCP servers
One-click install and hosted deployment options
Strong community adoption as the default marketplace
tools.best_for: Discovering, installing, and hosting MCP servers quickly

tools.name: Cloudflare MCP / Remote MCP
tools.connects_to: Hosted remote MCP servers on Workers with OAuth, plus access to Cloudflare services (DNS, R2, D1, Workers, logs)
tools.pricing_paid: Free tier via Workers; usage-based Workers/paid plans for scale
strengths: Turns MCP servers into scalable remote, authenticated endpoints
First-class support for building and hosting remote MCP servers
Integrates Cloudflare's own infrastructure as agent tools
tools.best_for: Deploying production remote MCP servers with OAuth at the edge

tools.name: mcp.so
tools.connects_to: A large public directory indexing thousands of MCP servers and clients for discovery
strengths: Comprehensive, frequently updated catalog of servers
Popular starting point for finding servers by category
Simple browsing and search experience
tools.best_for: Browsing and discovering the full breadth of available MCP servers

tools.name: Supabase MCP Server
tools.connects_to: Supabase/Postgres databases — querying, schema management, migrations and project operations
tools.pricing_paid: Free with Supabase free tier; Pro plans from ~$25/mo
strengths: Official server for direct database interaction by agents
Lets agents inspect schema and run SQL safely
Popular among full-stack developers building with Supabase
tools.best_for: Agent-driven database querying and backend management on Supabase
